name: boomi-runtime
description: Provisions a temporary Boomi runtime in the session and hands its ID to Boomi Companion

namePrefix.title: Runtime name prefix
namePrefix.description: Start of every runtime name this mod creates; /boomi reap deletes offline runtimes with this prefix

installRoot.title: Install root
installRoot.description: Folder the runtime is installed under; empty means ~/.boomi-runtimes

envFile.title: Companion .env file
envFile.description: Path of Boomi Companion's .env, relative to the session's working directory

installerUrl.title: Installer URL
installerUrl.description: Where the Linux runtime installer is downloaded from

installerArgs.title: Extra installer arguments
installerArgs.description: Added to the quiet install command, space separated (proxy settings, for example)

ephemeral.title: Delete at session end
ephemeral.description: Stop the runtime, delete it from the platform and remove its files when the session ends
